description: I2IDL-X alignment for performance support, instruction and evaluation around play. This profile does not model the game, its world, combat, economy or seasons.
method: Review the actual instructional content; preserve canonical concept identifiers and definitions; express aboutness without equivalence or mastery claims.

job-aid.function: Support execution of a task during play

reference.function: Provide information needed at the point of performance

concept.function: Content that can be composed into instruction

field-note:keep.rationale: The job aid explains the sequence for taking a keep and the need for a warband.

field-note:keepheld.rationale: The job aid explains what to do after capture so a keep can be garrisoned.

lore:3.rationale: As instruction, the page explains relationships between keep control, temple vulnerability and hallow effects.
